status: Closed — Fixed; empty-queue takeover admission and current sealed runner publication verified
area: Runner-sync publication takeover admission is circular after recovery-retained release
finding: broker runner-sync takeover-publication required an active queue-head even when the steward queue was empty. A recovery-retained sealed build correctly releases the queue so foreign generated outputs are not silently published, but the next official recovery command then fails with ATM_RUNNER_PUBLICATION_PENDING. Operators cannot authorize the same generated members without enqueueing first, and enqueueing without takeover is what the publication authority contract forbids.
expectedBehavior: When the steward queue is empty, takeover-publication must admit if the actor holds the live recovery claim and the sealed source SHA matches HEAD. Queue-head plus exact SHA remains required when a reservation already exists. Wrong actor, foreign SHA, or a different queue-head must stay fail-closed.
evidenceOrRepro: ATM-GOV-0370 second publication window, 2026-08-15. After runner-sync-06365e10 published recovery-retained and released the queue, `node atm.mjs broker runner-sync takeover-publication --task ATM-GOV-0370 --actor cursor-captain --sealed-source-sha 91ade92dcf2275391f56253fcc78e36331f0a865 --surface full --json` returned ATM_RUNNER_PUBLICATION_PENDING. Saved at .atm/history/evidence/ATM-GOV-0370.takeover-publication-refusal.json. Owner forbade a further enqueue before a complete takeover plan.
